entry.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models Revisited
entry.summary: We revisit scaling laws for large language models and find that compute-optimal training requires larger models than previously thought. Our experiments across multiple model families confirm a new set of scaling coefficients.

entry.title: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision Transformers via Low-Rank Adaptation
entry.summary: We propose ViT-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method for fine-tuning vision transformers that achieves competitive performance with full fine-tuning using only 0.5% of trainable parameters.

entry.title: Mixture of Experts for Efficient Inference at Scale
entry.summary: This paper presents a novel routing mechanism for sparse mixture-of-experts models that reduces inference cost by 3x while maintaining model quality on standard benchmarks.
